bodyInfo.fontFamily: Roboto, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI", Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Fira Sans", "Droid Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

sampleRules: .Menu .bubble { --offset-y: calc(100% + .5rem); --offset-x: 0; --animation-start-scale: .85; z-index: var(--z-menu-bubble); transform: scale(var(--animation-start-scale)); overscroll-behavior: contain; border-radius: var(--border-radius-menu); min-width: 13.5rem; color: var(--color-text); background-color: var(--color-background); box-shadow: 0 .25rem .5rem .125rem var(--color-default-shadow); corner-shape: squircle; margin: 0px; padding: 0.5rem 0px; list-style: none; display: block; position: absolute; overflow: hidden; transition: opacity 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1) !important; }

.MenuItem .right-badge { min-width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-align: center; background: var(--color-gray); border-radius: 0.75rem; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: auto; padding: 0px 0.4375rem; line-height: 1.5rem; }
.MenuItem .menu-item-badge { color: var(--color-primary); margin-right: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: normal; }
.Avatar.message-bubble { --radius: 0; mask-image: url("./blue-jkppS-_n.svg"); mask-position: 50% center; mask-size: 100% auto; mask-repeat: no-repeat; }
.Checkbox .user-avatar { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s; position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; }
.Checkbox.blocking input:not(:checked) ~ .Checkbox-main::after { content: ""; opacity: 1; background-color: var(--color-error); border-radius: 0.25rem; }
.Checkbox input { z-index: var(--z-below); opacity: 0; position: absolute; }
.Checkbox .Checkbox-main .user-avatar, .Checkbox .Checkbox-main::before, .Checkbox .Checkbox-main::after { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 1.125rem; transform: translateY(-50%); }

.Checkbox .Nested-avatar-list::before, .Checkbox .Nested-avatar-list::after { pointer-events: none; content: ""; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; display: block; position: absolute; left: 1.125rem; }

.CountryCodeInput .input-group .css-icon-down { border-right-color: ; border-right-style: ; border-right-width: ; border-bottom-color: ; border-bottom-style: ; border-bottom-width: ; border-image-source: ; border-image-slice: ; border-image-width: ; border-image-outset: ; border-image-repeat: ; border-top: 0px; border-left: 0px; width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; transition: color 0.2s, transform 0.2s, top 0.2s; position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1rem; transform: scaleY(1) rotate(45deg); }
.CountryCodeInput .input-group .css-icon-down.open { border-color: var(--color-primary); top: 1.3125rem; transform: scaleY(-1) rotate(45deg); }
.CountryCodeInput .bubble { --animation-start-scale: .95; width: 100%; max-height: 23.5rem; overflow-y: auto; transform-origin: center top !important; }

.input-group label { pointer-events: none; cursor: var(--custom-cursor,text); transform-origin: 0px center; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: var(--font-weight-normal); color: var(--color-placeholders); white-space: nowrap; background-color: var(--color-background); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0px 0.5rem; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; display: block; position: absolute; top: 0.6875rem; left: 1rem; }

.input-group.with-arrow::after { content: ""; border-bottom: 1px var(--color-text-secondary) solid; border-left: 1px var(--color-text-secondary) solid; width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 2rem; transform: rotate(-45deg); }

.input-group.touched label, .input-group.error label, .input-group.success label, .input-group .form-control:focus + label, .input-group .form-control.focus + label { transform: scale(0.75) translateY(-2rem); }

.input-group[dir="rtl"].with-arrow::after { border-right: 1px var(--color-text-secondary) solid; border-left-width: medium; border-left-style: none; border-left-color: currentcolor; left: 2rem; right: auto; }

.input-group[dir="rtl"].touched label, .input-group[dir="rtl"].error label, .input-group[dir="rtl"].success label, .input-group[dir="rtl"] .form-control:focus + label, .input-group[dir="rtl"] .form-control.focus + label { transform: scale(0.75) translate(1.5rem, -2.25rem); }

.input-group.password-input .toggle-password { cursor: var(--custom-cursor,pointer); width: 3rem; height: 3rem; color: var(--color-text); opacity: 1; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-size: 1.5rem; display: flex; position: absolute; top: 0px; right: 0px; outline: none !important; }
.chat-list { background: var(--color-background); height: 100%; padding: 0.5rem; padding-inline-end: max(.5rem - var(--scrollbar-width), 0px); overflow: hidden scroll; }
body.is-ios .chat-list .ListItem::after, body.is-android .chat-list .ListItem::after { opacity: 1; transition: opacity var(--layer-transition); }
.composer-pill { padding: var(--composer-pill-padding); border-radius: var(--composer-pill-radius); background: var(--color-background); }

.composer-action-button-pill { width: var(--composer-main-button-width); height: var(--composer-main-button-height); border-radius: var(--composer-control-radius); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); background: var(--color-primary); flex-shrink: 0; }
#middle-column-portals, #portals { height: 0px; position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; }
